### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://en.wikipedia.org/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2F)

### Comment
> When using chromium browsers (chrome and edge tested), dns over https feature with standart setting of adguard dns wikipedia pages of any language return a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN ERROR not returning the ip addresses for wikipedia pages, problem also persist in android chromium browsers and other setups of adguard dns like dns over tls or router settings with plain adguard dns ip adresses. Wikipedia seems to be the only relevant site that appears to be a false positve.



### Screenshots

  <summary>Screenshot 1</summary>
